assign.outcome:
**Five loose ends closed, each verified headless on a private server.**

1. **The CMS wall's blank card** — [/imagine/cms/](/imagine/cms/) — shot `/imagine/cms/d1/` at 1280×800 jpeg (`shots/d1.jpg`, 92KB) and registered it in the `SHOTS` map. 6 img tags, 6 requests, all HTTP 200, zero failed.
2. **A branch row can be a link** — [/layouts/shell/](/layouts/shell/) · [the decision](/framework/ux/Tree/doc/decisions/) — `ux/Tree`'s own merge (landed 23:47, unrelated task) had already simplified `Row.prerender()` to `href ? "a" : "div"` with no kids check. Found and fixed the real bug that exposed: the chevron's `click` handler only called `stopPropagation()`, which never stops an `<a>` row's own default navigation, so folding a branch also followed its link — added `preventDefault()` to `caret()`/`mark()`/`button()`. Deleted `Shell.Tree.Row`, the now-dead override Shell.js carried to work around the old behaviour. Verified on 8 real shell rows: every href row is an `<a>`, chevron click leaves the url unchanged and flips `.ui-tree-open` true→false, a label click navigates, Enter on the focused branch row follows its href.
3. **The named stale doc turned out already clean** — [the doc](/framework/ext/AITask/doc/file/ai.css.md) — grepped the file, its committed HEAD and its two prior commits: no `calc(var(--gap) * N)` text exists anywhere in its history. Read it line-by-line against the current `ai.css` instead and found a real inaccuracy: "Improvements" #1 described three near-identical `width: auto` overrides that are now one (`framework.css` gained a `select.auto` utility 2026-08-28, resolving two of them) — struck through and corrected.
4. **A layout-skill line** — `.claude/skills/layout/improvements.md` (not SKILL.md) — the skill warns wrapping layouts misalign at awkward counts two lines before saying walls take `grid auto-fill`; the site measured the contradiction twice the same night (catalog wall: 5 columns, last row of 1, 2800–3360px; shell wall: same shape at 1920). One line with both numbers, for the mastermind to judge.
5. **A core doc note** — [the css doc](/framework/core/Page/doc/css/) — three sentences, doc only, no CSS touched: the columns stand-down rule (`Page.css:39`) leaves a default ANCESTOR showing, right for a columns host and wrong for a two-region host that replaces one child with another, plus the two-region form from the shell-lab log.

**Left: nothing open.** Two items (2 and 3) turned out already partly resolved by concurrent work; both were verified against the live site rather than taken on faith, and the real remaining gap in each was found and fixed instead.
